subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 13 upstream action revisions for secret-bearing and release automation after the exact-head runs complete and an owner reviews the changed action contracts?
rationale: This is an intentional third-party execution-surface update affecting GitHub App tokens, Docker credentials, security scanning, and Codex automation; the acceptable supplier-change and proof threshold is a maintainer security/operations decision.

options.title: Validate and approve the supplier update
options.body: Review the upstream action revisions and attach or inspect redacted successful runs for representative app-token, Codex, and Docker paths before merging.

options.title: Hold selected pins
options.body: Keep any action whose contract or workflow result is not yet acceptable at its existing immutable revision and split the remaining validated updates into a narrower PR.

options.title: Pause the batch update
options.body: Close or defer this batch if the repository cannot provide accountable validation for the credential-bearing workflow paths.

recommendation.title: Validate and approve the supplier update
recommendation.body: Review the upstream action revisions and attach or inspect redacted successful runs for representative app-token, Codex, and Docker paths before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: No more specific current-main workflow owner was available in the supplied history, so repository workflow ownership is the closest routing signal.
